comment: 50 theme prototype briefs for zudo-doc issue #2811. Seeds 01-09 come from the user's reference dialog screenshot; 10 is the user's own wisdom-repo Futura example. Each brief is a design direction — the prototype agent owns the concrete palette/typography within it. Every prototype must define BOTH light and dark token sets; 'mode' is the primary/default mode the theme is designed around.

briefs.name: Foundry
briefs.concept: Classic GitHub-neutral — clean, conventional developer-doc look. The safe default.
briefs.typography: Inter or system-ui stack, semibold headings
briefs.palette: white bg, near-black text, classic blue links, gray borders
briefs.signature: restraint — this is the baseline theme done perfectly

briefs.name: Ledger
briefs.concept: Cream academic serif, Tufte-inspired — warm paper, oxblood links, sidenote elegance.
briefs.typography: Crimson Pro / ET-Book-like serif body, italic subheads
briefs.palette: cream #fffff8-ish paper, ink text, oxblood #8b1a1a links
briefs.signature: hairline rules, generous measure, understated code blocks

briefs.name: Broadsheet
briefs.concept: Newspaper editorial — drop-cap, masthead ink rules, column discipline.
briefs.typography: Playfair Display or old-style display for h1 masthead, Source Serif body
briefs.palette: newsprint white, rich black ink, one deep red accent
briefs.signature: drop cap on first paragraph, double-rule borders under headings

briefs.name: Swissgrid
briefs.concept: International Typographic Style — Helvetica grid, one hot-red accent, ruthless alignment.
briefs.typography: Helvetica/Inter tight tracking, font-weight contrast, no italics
briefs.palette: white, black, Swiss red #ff0000 accent only
briefs.signature: visible baseline-grid background hint, oversized section numbers

briefs.name: Manuscript
briefs.concept: Garamond literary — quiet book page, small-caps subheads.
briefs.typography: EB Garamond body, small-caps h2/h3, old-style numerals feel
briefs.palette: warm white, soft black, muted sepia accents
briefs.signature: small-caps + letterspaced subheads, centered ornamental hr

briefs.name: Solar
briefs.concept: Solarized-Light precision — balanced low-eyestrain technical palette.
briefs.typography: Source Sans 3 body, Source Code Pro code
briefs.palette: solarized base3/base2 bg, base00 text, blue/cyan/orange accents
briefs.signature: the classic solarized selective-contrast feel, technical calm

briefs.name: Drift
briefs.concept: Soft slate-blue dark — floaty, low-contrast comfort dark for long reading.
briefs.typography: IBM Plex Sans, relaxed line-height
briefs.palette: blue-gray #1e2530-ish bg, desaturated blue accents, soft white text
briefs.signature: soft glows instead of borders, gentle elevation

briefs.name: Hollow
briefs.concept: Dark violet space — neon pink headings, purple links, midnight depth.
briefs.typography: modern geometric sans (Space Grotesk?)
briefs.palette: deep indigo-black bg, hot pink #ff79c6-ish headings, violet links
briefs.signature: neon accent discipline — pink only for headings/links, everything else calm

briefs.name: Hearth
briefs.concept: Warm cream + brick red — cozy fireside documentation.
briefs.typography: rounded humanist sans or gentle serif mix
briefs.palette: warm cream bg, brick/rust red headings and accents, brown-black text
briefs.signature: warm shadows, soft radius, amber code blocks

briefs.name: Futura Editorial
briefs.concept: The user's own wisdom-repo theme: geometric Futura headings at normal weight, Noto Sans body. Easy-apply archetype.
briefs.typography: Futura/Jost geometric headings font-weight:400, Noto Sans body
briefs.palette: clean white, near-black, one restrained accent
briefs.signature: font-normal headings with tight tracking — typography does all the work

briefs.name: Phosphor
briefs.concept: Green CRT terminal — phosphor glow, scanlines, everything monospace.
briefs.typography: monospace everywhere (JetBrains Mono / VT323 accents)
briefs.palette: near-black, phosphor green #33ff66 range, dim green borders
briefs.signature: subtle scanline bg, text-shadow glow on headings, ASCII-style rules

briefs.name: E-Ink
briefs.concept: E-reader grayscale — paper-device calm, zero color except one functional accent.
briefs.typography: Literata or Bookerly-like reading serif
briefs.palette: pure grayscale ramp, single dark-teal functional accent for links
briefs.signature: no shadows, no gradients, crisp 1px grays — device-like stillness

briefs.name: Blueprint
briefs.concept: Cyanotype engineering drawing — white line-work on blueprint blue.
briefs.typography: technical: Inter + mono labels in caps
briefs.palette: prussian blueprint blue bg, white/cyan lines and text, yellow highlight accent
briefs.signature: grid-paper background, dashed borders, title-block style header

briefs.name: Washi
briefs.concept: Japanese paper — warm washi texture, indigo (藍) accents, quiet asymmetry.
briefs.typography: Noto Sans JP / Zen Kaku Gothic feel, generous line-height for JP text
briefs.palette: warm off-white washi, sumi ink text, ai-iro indigo #274a78 accents
briefs.signature: subtle paper-grain bg, vertical-rhythm discipline, indigo stamp accents

briefs.name: Sumi
briefs.concept: Sumi-e ink — bold black brush contrast, vermillion seal accent.
briefs.typography: high-contrast: strong serif/mincho headings, clean sans body
briefs.palette: white, deep sumi black, one vermillion #d9333f seal-red accent
briefs.signature: thick ink-stroke heading underlines, hanko-like red square accents

briefs.name: Sakura
briefs.concept: Cherry-blossom pastel — soft pink and plum, gentle rounded warmth.
briefs.typography: rounded sans (M PLUS Rounded / Quicksand feel)
briefs.palette: blush white bg, sakura pink accents, plum text
briefs.signature: petal-soft radius, pink-tinted code blocks, spring lightness without kitsch

briefs.name: Matcha
briefs.concept: Green tea ceremony — deep matcha greens on cream, zen spacing.
briefs.typography: calm humanist sans, airy spacing
briefs.palette: cream bg, matcha/moss green range, charcoal text
briefs.signature: generous whitespace, tea-foam subtle bg tint on surfaces

briefs.name: Fjord
briefs.concept: Arctic bluish dark — cold nordic calm, frost accents (nord-adjacent but original).
briefs.typography: Inter, crisp and neutral
briefs.palette: polar-night blue-gray bg, frost cyan/blue accents, snow text
briefs.signature: cool desaturated harmony, icy borders, aurora-teal links

briefs.name: Barnwood
briefs.concept: Retro warm dark — woody browns and harvest hues (gruvbox-adjacent but original).
briefs.typography: slab-ish or sturdy sans headings
briefs.palette: dark umber bg, cream text, orange/aqua/yellow retro accents
briefs.signature: warm low-blue comfort, chunky borders, vintage-terminal energy

briefs.name: Nocturne
briefs.concept: Purple midnight — velvet dark with lavender and gold accents, elegant not neon.
briefs.typography: elegant sans with serif display h1
briefs.palette: deep aubergine-black, lavender links, muted gold highlights
briefs.signature: velvet-depth surfaces, gold hairline rules

briefs.name: Abyss
briefs.concept: Deep ocean — navy depths, bioluminescent cyan, pressure-calm reading.
briefs.typography: clean geometric sans
briefs.palette: near-black navy, cyan/teal glow accents, pale blue text
briefs.signature: depth-gradient page bg (top lighter, bottom darker), glowing link hover

briefs.name: Aurora
briefs.concept: Northern lights — dark sky with teal→violet gradient accents.
briefs.typography: modern sans, light weights
briefs.palette: night-sky bg, aurora gradient (teal-green-violet) on headings/accents
briefs.signature: gradient text on h1, subtle star-dust bg, gradient border on active items

briefs.name: Cyberdeck
briefs.concept: Cyberpunk terminal — neon on near-black, angular, a little dangerous.
briefs.typography: mono headings in caps, tight technical sans body
briefs.palette: black, neon magenta + electric cyan dual accents, warning yellow
briefs.signature: clipped corner boxes, neon left-borders, glitch-style h1 underline

briefs.name: Vaporwave
briefs.concept: Retro-future mall at midnight — pink/cyan chrome, 90s web nostalgia done tastefully.
briefs.typography: wide display headings, letterspaced
briefs.palette: deep purple-black, hot pink + cyan, sunset gradient accents
briefs.signature: horizon-grid footer bg, chrome-gradient h1, palm-tone shadows

briefs.name: Synthwave
briefs.concept: Sunset horizon drive — orange→magenta gradient heat over dark asphalt.
briefs.typography: bold italic display h1, clean body
briefs.palette: asphalt black, sunset orange/magenta gradient accents, warm white text
briefs.signature: gradient heading rule like a horizon line, warm glow code blocks

briefs.name: Brutalist
briefs.concept: Raw concrete web — stark black on white, thick borders, zero radius, honest structure.
briefs.typography: mono or grotesque headings in caps, dense body
briefs.palette: white, black, one warning-orange accent
briefs.signature: 4px solid black borders, no shadows, no radius, visible structure everywhere

briefs.name: Bauhaus
briefs.concept: Form follows function — primary red/yellow/blue geometry, bold and playful-serious.
briefs.typography: geometric sans (Jost/Futura-like), lowercase-leaning headings
briefs.palette: off-white, black, primary red + yellow + blue used structurally
briefs.signature: geometric shape accents (circle/triangle/square bullets), color-blocked admonitions

briefs.name: Art Deco
briefs.concept: Gatsby elegance — black and gold, geometric luxury, 1920s poster grandeur.
briefs.typography: tall elegant display headings (Poiret-like), refined body
briefs.palette: rich black, champagne gold, ivory text
briefs.signature: gold fan/ray motifs on hr, double-line gold frames, letterspaced caps subheads

briefs.name: Memphis
briefs.concept: 80s Memphis design — playful squiggles, confetti geometry, sophisticated toy-box.
briefs.typography: chunky rounded headings, friendly body
briefs.palette: warm white, coral + teal + yellow + lilac confetti accents
briefs.signature: squiggle/dot pattern accents, offset shadow blocks, tilted decorations kept subtle

briefs.name: Halftone
briefs.concept: Comic print — halftone dots, ink outlines, speech-bubble admonitions. POW without the cheese.
briefs.typography: bold comic-adjacent headings (Bangers used sparingly), clean body
briefs.palette: paper white, ink black, ben-day red/yellow/blue
briefs.signature: halftone-dot backgrounds on surfaces, thick ink borders with offset shadow

briefs.name: Sketchbook
briefs.concept: Designer's notebook — hand-drawn borders, pencil grays, marginal-note energy.
briefs.typography: Caveat/Patrick Hand for accents only, clean sans body
briefs.palette: paper white, graphite text, highlighter-yellow accent
briefs.signature: wobbly hand-drawn borders (border-image feel), highlighter marks on links/strong

briefs.name: Academia
briefs.concept: LaTeX paper — Computer-Modern flavor, theorem-box admonitions, citation gravitas.
briefs.typography: Latin-Modern-like serif (STIX Two / CMU), math-paper conventions
briefs.palette: white, black, minimal navy links
briefs.signature: numbered theorem-style admonitions, centered small-caps h1, footnote rules

briefs.name: Chancery
briefs.concept: Legal document — formal, numbered, Century-schoolbook authority.
briefs.typography: Century/Schoolbook-like serif, formal hierarchy
briefs.palette: white, near-black, deep forest-green accents
briefs.signature: §-numbered headings, ruled sub-clauses, embossed-seal footer motif

briefs.name: Gloss
briefs.concept: Fashion magazine — huge thin Didot headlines, editorial whitespace, one lipstick accent.
briefs.typography: Didot/Bodoni-like thin display h1, refined sans body
briefs.palette: white, black, lipstick red accent
briefs.signature: oversized ultra-light headings, pull-quote styled blockquotes, hairline frames

briefs.name: Scandi
briefs.concept: Scandinavian interior — oat, sage, birch; hygge minimalism with warm function.
briefs.typography: soft geometric sans, comfortable sizes
briefs.palette: oat/linen bg, sage green + clay accents, warm charcoal text
briefs.signature: soft 12px radius, linen-tint surfaces, no hard black anywhere

briefs.name: Kinfolk
briefs.concept: Slow-living editorial — airy beige, serif calm, gallery whitespace.
briefs.typography: light serif headings, airy tracking, sans body
briefs.palette: warm beige/ecru, soft brown text, muted terracotta accent
briefs.signature: extreme whitespace, center-aligned h1 with letterspacing, quiet everything

briefs.name: Onyx
briefs.concept: Luxury noir — jet black, champagne serif, watch-brand restraint.
briefs.typography: serif display headings, refined sans body, wide letterspacing on labels
briefs.palette: true black, champagne/platinum text, single gold accent
briefs.signature: gold 1px rules, serif numerals, boutique-level minimalism

briefs.name: Timberline
briefs.concept: Forest cabin at night — deep pine greens, warm lantern amber, wood tones.
briefs.typography: sturdy humanist sans
briefs.palette: dark pine bg, cream text, amber/moss accents
briefs.signature: lantern-warm link glow, wood-grain-subtle surface tint

briefs.name: Adobe
briefs.concept: Desert southwest — terracotta, sand, clay geometry, warm sun.
briefs.typography: warm sans with slab headings
briefs.palette: sand bg, terracotta + clay + cactus green accents, brown text
briefs.signature: stepped-border (pueblo) motifs on admonitions, sun-baked warm shadows

briefs.name: Seaglass
briefs.concept: Coastal morning — driftwood gray, sea-glass green/blue, weathered calm.
briefs.typography: relaxed sans, airy
briefs.palette: fog white, driftwood gray text, seaglass teal + soft blue accents
briefs.signature: frosted-glass surfaces (subtle blur feel), tide-line hr

briefs.name: Bonbon
briefs.concept: Candy shop — saturated sweets, bubbly rounded, joyful but disciplined.
briefs.typography: rounded bold headings (Baloo-like), clean body
briefs.palette: cream bg, bubblegum pink + grape + mint + lemon accents
briefs.signature: pill-shaped tags/buttons, candy-stripe accent rule, big friendly radius

briefs.name: Macintosh
briefs.concept: Classic Mac System 7 — pixel-crisp chrome, 1-bit patterns, beige nostalgia.
briefs.typography: Chicago-like pixel display for h1/chrome (Pixelify/Silkscreen sparingly), Geneva-like body
briefs.palette: platinum gray chrome, black pinstripes, one classic rainbow accent
briefs.signature: title-bar styled headers with pinstripes, 1-bit dither pattern accents, square scrollbar vibes

briefs.name: Arcade
briefs.concept: 8-bit cabinet — pixel accents, sprite palette, CRT glow, insert coin.
briefs.typography: Press Start 2P for tiny labels/h1 only, readable sans body
briefs.palette: deep navy-black, sprite red/yellow/green/cyan, white text
briefs.signature: pixel-corner borders, score-board header, chunky pixel hr

briefs.name: HUD
briefs.concept: Sci-fi heads-up display — holographic cyan wireframes, corner brackets, telemetry.
briefs.typography: condensed technical sans + mono telemetry labels
briefs.palette: black, hologram cyan, alert amber, success green
briefs.signature: corner-bracket frames on surfaces, scan-line sweep accent, uppercase micro-labels

briefs.name: Observatory
briefs.concept: Night sky atlas — star-field depth, constellation lines, astronomer's calm.
briefs.typography: elegant thin sans, scientific
briefs.palette: space black-blue, star white, nebula violet + comet gold accents
briefs.signature: faint star-dot bg, constellation-line borders connecting dots, gold ecliptic hr

briefs.name: Botanica
briefs.concept: Vintage botanical plate — cream stock, deep green ink, fine engraved rules.
briefs.typography: serif with italic species-label accents
briefs.palette: cream, botanical deep green, sepia ink, pressed-flower rose accent
briefs.signature: engraved double-rule frames, italic latin-label captions, leaf-motif list markers

briefs.name: Beacon
briefs.concept: WCAG-AAA high contrast — 7:1+ everywhere, thick focus rings, clarity as beauty. (a11y as an aesthetic, per the issue)
briefs.typography: Atkinson Hyperlegible body, large sizes, strong hierarchy
briefs.palette: pure white, pure black, AAA-checked blue + dark red accents only
briefs.signature: 3px focus rings, underlined links always, oversized readable everything — beautiful because uncompromising

briefs.name: Amberterm
briefs.concept: Amber phosphor workstation — warm monochrome amber on black, VT-era serenity.
briefs.typography: mono-forward, humanist sans body option
briefs.palette: black, amber #ffb000 ramp only (dim to bright)
briefs.signature: single-hue discipline, amber intensity = hierarchy, block cursor accents

briefs.name: Zine
briefs.concept: Punk photocopy zine — newsprint gray, red stamp, cut-and-paste energy, controlled chaos.
briefs.typography: typewriter mono body accents, brash condensed headings
briefs.palette: newsprint off-white, xerox black, stamp red
briefs.signature: rotated stamp-style tags, rough torn-edge hr, typewriter code blocks

briefs.name: Glacier
briefs.concept: Ice-pale minimalism — barely-there blues, thin crisp lines, cold clean air.
briefs.typography: thin modern sans, precise
briefs.palette: ice white with blue undertone, glacier blue accents, slate text
briefs.signature: 1px crisp borders, frost-blue selection color, crystalline sparse accents
